summary: On paper Detroit has the edge (Detroit's defense ranks 1st in broken tackles per touch, 8.0% missed), while Green Bay's best counter is to win through the air (Green Bay ranks 10th in EPA per dropback, +0.18). Under center, Jared Goff ranks 9th of 26 in EPA per dropback and Jordan Love ranks 11th; x-factor: Sam LaPorta averages 3.7 yards of separation, 8th of 54, and Green Bay's pass defense ranks 8th. The model favors Detroit at 67%, mostly on rushing matchup (3.2 pts) and home field (1.7 pts).
